name: Howard Schubiner
reason: Re-checked 12 Nov 2026 (unlearnyourpain.com home): his own site is a physician's practice in 'Mind Body Medicine', with telehealth appointments and programmes, books and courses sold on recovering from chronic pain, fatigue, anxiety and depression (Freedom From Chronic Pain, Unlearn Your Pain, Pain Reprocessing Therapy and EAET clinician trainings). His work is medical treatment of conditions plus clinician trainings, and he leads no spiritual or contemplative practice outside it (the site's meditations serve the pain programme); nothing passes as spiritual teaching.
